protocol.unknown_policy: Unknown nunca recebe crédito, não rejeita mutação válida, bloqueia caso positivo obrigatório e só é o resultado correto dos controles opacos U01-U04.
protocol.order_policy: O vetor completo de classificações deve ser idêntico nas três ordens; divergência, crash, timeout ou resultado ausente é Unknown e bloqueia o selo.

authority.environment: shared workspace; allowlist procedural, not sandbox-enforced

read_allowlist: protected P1424 step and L0 inputs named by the manifest
ratified vanilla sources named by the manifest
productive files as they existed at baseline commit 79c7a6d60a29bcf53a3b06f15d800dcf286381a6
forbidden_reads: candidate implementation diffs or files after the frozen baseline
private outputs of implementer, oracle author, or verifier
forbidden_actions: correct or select the candidate implementation
edit manifest, contract, prompts, productive code, or oracle suite

authority.context: Task-scoped adversary instruction plus canonical manifest and contract only; no candidate implementation was inspected.

verified_hash_sets.protected_inputs: all 9 manifest-listed protected-input hashes matched at authorship
verified_hash_sets.productive_baseline: all 7 manifest-listed productive-file hashes matched git objects at baseline commit
verified_hash_sets.ratified_sources: all 4 manifest-listed vanilla source hashes matched at authorship

execution_orders.order: M01 through M21, then U01 through U04
M01 through M21, then U01 through U04
U04 through U01, then M21 through M01

mutations.mutation: Omit html.frame from the html scope, publish it under another name, or report a repr other than exactly frame.
mutations.witness: Under Feature::Html, either lookup fails in at least one target or #repr(html.frame) is not exactly frame; witness O-BINDING-FEATURE or O-CARRIER with the actual lookup/repr result.

mutations.mutation: Enable the binding whenever the selected output target is HTML, even when Feature::Html is disabled.
mutations.witness: The feature-off HTML profile successfully resolves html.frame; witness O-BINDING-FEATURE and the unexpected successful access.

mutations.mutation: Construct HtmlElem with tag frame, or another sentinel tag, instead of the distinct HtmlFrame carrier.
mutations.witness: Pre-layout inspection yields HtmlElem/tag morphology rather than Content::HtmlFrame(HtmlFrameElem { body }); HTML contains a literal tag or conflates the primitive with html.elem("frame").

mutations.mutation: Return Empty, pre-rendered SVG bytes, or the bare body directly from html.frame construction.
mutations.witness: Before target-specific consumption, the value is not the distinct carrier and repr is not frame(body: [x]); witness O-CARRIER with the actual variant and morphology.

mutations.mutation: Treat HtmlFrame as terminal in a walker, skip its body, or let map_content/map_text rebuild it as Empty, HtmlElem, or bare body.
mutations.witness: A pre-layout walk/map over html.frame([x]) either does not visit x or no longer returns Content::HtmlFrame with repr frame(body: [x]); witness O-CARRIER naming the failed traversal or reconstructed variant.

mutations.mutation: Expose HtmlFrame through elem_name/func/repr as elem or html.elem("frame") rather than frame(body: ...).
mutations.witness: Reflection reports elem or html.elem morphology for the primitive, or reports frame morphology for the literal tag; witness O-CARRIER or O-LITERAL-FRAME-TAG with both actual representations.

mutations.mutation: Accept html.frame() by defaulting body to Empty or none.
mutations.witness: html.frame() succeeds or emits any diagnostic other than the public missing argument: body diagnostic; witness O-SIGNATURE with exit status and diagnostic.

mutations.mutation: Accept body as a named argument or route frame through a generic named-argument constructor.
mutations.witness: html.frame(body: [x]) succeeds or does not emit the argument `body` is positional; witness O-SIGNATURE with exit status and diagnostic.

mutations.mutation: Ignore, concatenate, or otherwise accept a second positional argument.
mutations.witness: html.frame([x], [y]) succeeds or does not emit unexpected argument; witness O-SIGNATURE with exit status and diagnostic.

mutations.mutation: In paged layout, create a wrapper frame/item, margin, offset, canvas, or extra page around the body.
mutations.witness: Compared with bare x, language morphology, position, supported visual output, page count, or geometry differs; witness O-PAGED-TRANSPARENCY with the first semantic delta.

mutations.mutation: Resolve the HtmlFrame body under the outer Html target instead of installing a localized Paged target for the island.
mutations.witness: The occurrence becomes ordinary HTML, literal frame markup, empty content, wrong geometry, or nested islands rather than one intrinsic SVG; witness O-HTML-INLINE-SVG or O-NESTING.

mutations.mutation: Paginate the entire HTML document, or enter frame resolution even when the prepared tree contains no HtmlFrame occurrence.
mutations.witness: A no-frame fixture changes its golden DOM/bytes, acquires paged wrappers, or records entry into the frame phase; witness O-FAIL-CLOSED with the first changed public output.

mutations.mutation: Serialize the body as ordinary HTML/text, escape the generated SVG, or wrap it in p/frame markup.
mutations.witness: The useful DOM lacks one unescaped inline svg at the source position or contains escaped <svg, p, or frame wrapper; witness O-HTML-INLINE-SVG with the actual useful root.

mutations.mutation: Reuse standalone page SVG with A4/page dimensions, background fill, or page canvas instead of an intrinsic transparent root.
mutations.witness: The rect fixture root has a page-sized viewBox/dimensions or page background instead of transparent viewBox 0 0 10 5 and coherent 10pt by 5pt dimensions within 0.001pt; witness O-GEOMETRY-PAINT-TEXT.

mutations.mutation: Scale, pad, translate, round materially, or clip the intrinsic rect geometry.
mutations.witness: Extracted numeric viewBox or physical size differs from 10 by 5 beyond 0.001pt, or supported red ink is clipped/offset; witness O-GEOMETRY-PAINT-TEXT with extracted numbers.

mutations.mutation: Drop visible text, red paint, effective text style, font context, or image/metric context while laying out or rendering the island.
mutations.witness: The text fixture no longer visibly contains x, or the rect fixture no longer carries supported red paint; witness O-GEOMETRY-PAINT-TEXT naming the missing visual morphology.

mutations.mutation: Omit or change the default block-level display annotation on the inline SVG.
mutations.witness: The useful svg root does not semantically establish display:block in the default P1424 case; witness O-HTML-INLINE-SVG with the computed/declared display.

mutations.mutation: Resolve a nested HtmlFrame independently, producing two SVG roots, an embedded SVG island, duplicated text, or distinct geometry.
mutations.witness: Nested and simple fixtures differ geometrically/visually, or nested HTML contains other than exactly one useful inline svg; witness O-NESTING with SVG count and semantic delta.

mutations.mutation: Special-case html.elem("frame") as the primitive, route it through frame resolution, or emit SVG instead of a literal DOM element.
mutations.witness: The literal constructor no longer produces a literal frame element or is promoted to inline svg; witness O-LITERAL-FRAME-TAG with the useful DOM node.

mutations.mutation: Convert unsupported layout/SVG content, crash, timeout, unresolved occurrence, or render error into successful empty output, omitted occurrence, bare text, or literal frame tag.
mutations.witness: The unsupported fixture exits successfully with an empty/omitted/fallback node instead of returning the underlying error or explicit Unknown; witness O-FAIL-CLOSED with status and fallback observed.

mutations.mutation: Let an exporter entry point without a resolver silently ignore, flatten, or stringify an unresolved HtmlFrame.
mutations.witness: An unresolved frame reaches export and still returns success without an attributable SVG; witness O-FAIL-CLOSED with the successful fallback or omitted occurrence.

opaque_controls.input: Successful process output whose extractor cannot establish one unambiguous useful svg root.
Output truncated or unreadable before DOM, geometry, or diagnostic classification.
Reference or candidate identity does not match its frozen hash.
Case exceeds the per-case or total calibration budget.

claim_boundary: This suite attacks only the P1424 fragment named by the manifest and contract. It does not claim general HTML/SVG parity, byte equality, SVG ID or attribute-order equality, box-based display suppression, generated CSS, anchors/link targets, pretty formatting, or unsupported content support.
